title: Learning
description: Frontmatter schema for files in 05 Learnings/. Reusable patterns and lessons from the project.

uid.description: ULID identifier. Unique across all vault entries.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the learning was captured (YYYY-MM-DD).

author.description: GitHub handle of the person who wrote this entry.

tags.description: Topic tags for discovery. Use lowercase-hyphenated strings (e.g. 'rate-limiting', 'auth', 'postgres').
